description: Map the professional graph around a target company. Finds senior decision-makers at the account, pulls each target's recent posts/reactions/comments to identify engagers, then scores every connection and produces a prioritized outreach queue. The response lists the selected `targets` (target_id, person_id, full_name, current_title, linkedin_url) and `_meta.next_step(s)`: get_outreach_queue for the scored queue, then get_outreach_path (free) to check warm paths to the top targets. Pools: coworker = other senior people at the same account from the lead search (no relationship with you is implied); engager = someone a target engages with; mutual = someone several targets engage with. Costs at most 1 + 3 × max_targets credits (7 at max_targets=2, 16 at the default 5, 61 at 20); the balance must cover that worst case, and only what is actually spent is charged and reported in the response.

max_targets.description: Max targets to deep-map per account (1-20, default 5). Each target adds up to 3 credits.

title_keywords.description: Title keywords to filter targets. Default: ['VP','Director','Head of','Chief']
